_comment: Everything the gacha can give out. Edit this file on GitHub and the next deploy has it — no code changes. A gif is a reaction that joins the pool the kana and grammar drills draw from. Images are filenames in this folder (put them in gifs/), a path like ../feedback/correct.gif, or a full https:// URL.
_duplicateRefund: Fraction of the cost paid back when a pull is one you already own.
_draw: 'uniform' — every prize equally likely, so adding one never changes what the others were worth. 'rarity' — weighted by the table below instead. While the pool is still being filled in, uniform is the honest one; under it the rarity of a prize is only its colour, and no odds are claimed on screen.
_rarities: Only used when draw is 'rarity'. Weights are relative, not percentages — they need not add to 100.
_prizes: Add one by copying an entry: drop the gif in gifs/, give it a unique id, set 'on' to 'correct' or 'wrong', and write the line that goes under it. Ids are what the save file remembers, so never reuse one for a different prize. 'note' is optional flavour shown in the collection. Skins are still supported — type 'skin' with a 'vars' object of CSS custom properties — but none are in the pool for now.
